novelty: Adds only the joint mu+delta removal arm on fresh SELECT triplets, completing the exact two-factor causal factorial and measuring downstream Mobius interaction on centered-type and common-support closer axes.
interaction_definition: For axis A in {S,M}, I_A=A_remove_both-A_remove_mu-A_remove_delta+A_native. Normalize sqrt(I_S^2+I_M^2) by sqrt((S_remove_both-S_native)^2+(M_remove_both-M_native)^2)+1e-6.

opposing_predictions.additive_oblique: median normalized interaction <=0.25 in each family; clean axis separation failed because the downstream output map is oblique, not because mu and delta combine nonadditively
opposing_predictions.nonlinear_interaction: median normalized interaction >0.25 in either family; shared and contrast terms combine downstream, explaining the failed clean separation
